spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: says they can't afford this, they've got nothing left until payday

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Rhys Sutherland. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and honestly I’m really unhappy with the bank about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to call about this, Rhys. Before we discuss any account details, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s all verified. Can you tell me the payment you’re concerned about?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s £186.40 to Northstar Digital on Tuesday. I’ve never used them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can understand why that’s worrying. I’m logging this as a complaint as well as noting the payment you don’t recognise.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good, because I can’t afford this. I’ve got nothing left until payday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m really sorry, Rhys. That must be stressful. I can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, who can talk through options like extra time if you need it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And don’t worry, we’ll get that £186.40 back to you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. What happens now?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll pass the details to our card team and someone will be in touch about it. I can’t give you a timescale just now, but I’ll keep ownership of this and call you by the end of tomorrow with an update.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, I’ve logged your complaint and the unrecognised payment, I’ll refer it to the card team, and I’ll call you by the end of tomorrow. I can also arrange for Financial Support to speak with you. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. Thanks for listening.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Rhys. I’m sorry again you’re dealing with this, and I’ll make sure you hear from me by tomorrow.
